d: A workshop makeover sounds simple until the sledgehammers come out! The OCC crew goes all in on demolition as Paul Sr. pushes to create more space for the shop's growing motorcycle business. But tearing down walls, shifting equipment, and cleaning up the rubble take valuable time away from the current bike build. With deadlines approaching, Paul Jr. and the fabricators must get back to work and make up for lost hours. Experience the chaos, comedy, and deadline pressure in this American Chopper episode.
